rock: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable base-color rock texture for a cute 3D cave game. Square flat orthographic texture fills entire frame edge to edge. Painted desaturated cool blue slate and violet charcoal stone, large irregular fractured planes and thin dark branching crevices, layered broad patches, softly brushed anime background detail, subtle wear on edges. Medium value slate blue gray rather than near black so physical cave lighting can shade it. Low contrast no deep shadows, NO light sources, NO cyan luminous veins, NO perspective, NO objects, no directional highlights, no vignette, no text, no borders. The texture is applied to modeled layered crag walls and rock sockets, must not look like regularly stacked bricks. Seamless edges all four sides.
floor: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable cave ground base-color texture for cute fixed top-down 3D game. Square flat texture full bleed. Smooth worn cave slate bedrock in desaturated blue gray with faint muted violet, broad irregular softly painted stone plates and hairline fissures, occasional tiny mineral specks. Anime hand-painted background style. Subtle, quiet low contrast to keep walking path legible, medium dark gray value but no baked shadows, no directional lighting, no glow, no crystals, no large rocks, no vegetation, no text or border, no perspective. All edges tile seamlessly, avoid regular polygon grid or noisy gravel.
